title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 202 ]

blocks.text: Few people are aware that 1883 is an important year in the history of the Korean press. In that year the newspaper was first published in Korea in an effort to educate the people and bring necessary changes to the country. Three times a month it brought the readers news about the country and the rest of the world. A year later the newspaper was discontinued for a while due to a fire. It had to close in 1888 because of lack of money. In spite of its short life, it changed forever how people got their news in Korea.

readingSentences.english: Few people are aware that 1883 is an important year in the history of the Korean press.
readingSentences.korean: 1883년이 한국 언론의 역사에서 중요한 연도라는 사실을 알고 있는 사람은 거의 없다.

readingSentences.english: In that year the newspaper was first published in Korea in an effort to educate the people and bring necessary changes to the country.
readingSentences.korean: 그 해에 한국에서 신문이 최초로 발간되었는데, 국민을 교육하고 필요한 변화를 한국에 가져오기 위한 노력의 일환이었다.

readingSentences.english: Three times a month it brought the readers news about the country and the rest of the world.
readingSentences.korean: 한 달에 세 번씩 그 신문은 국내와 외부 세계에 대한 뉴스를 독자들에게 가져다 주었다.

readingSentences.english: A year later the newspaper was discontinued for a while due to a fire.
readingSentences.korean: 일년 후에, 그 신문은 화재 때문에 잠시 동안 중단되었다.

readingSentences.english: It had to close in 1888 because of lack of money.
readingSentences.korean: 그 신문은 1888년에 자금 부족 때문에 폐간해야 했다.

readingSentences.english: In spite of its short life, it changed forever how people got their news in Korea.
readingSentences.korean: 그 짧은 생명에도 불구하고, 그 신문은 한국에서 사람들이 뉴스를 얻는 방법을 영원히 변화시켰던 것이다.
